description:
Experience one of the most unique riding environments in California on this 4-hour advanced eBike tour in the stunning Sierra Nevada near Bass Lake. This ride is designed for experienced mountain bikers seeking technical challenges, breathtaking scenery, and unforgettable terrain.

The adventure takes you deep into the high-elevation forests and granite landscapes that make this region famous. Ride flowing singletrack through towering pines before climbing onto massive granite domes that offer panoramic views of the surrounding Sierra peaks and Bass Lake below. The terrain features steep granite slabs, technical rock features, challenging climbs, and thrilling descents that demand strong bike-handling skills and confidence on exposed rock.

Your electric mountain bike provides the power to conquer sustained climbs and maximize time on the trail, allowing you to explore more of this incredible backcountry terrain. Along the route, you'll experience a mix of smooth forest singletrack, technical granite traverses, rocky switchbacks, and exhilarating downhill sections that showcase some of the area's best riding.

Tour Highlights

4-hour guided advanced eBike experience
High-elevation Sierra Nevada scenery
Epic rides across massive granite domes
Technical singletrack and challenging rock features
Steep granite climbs and descents
Spectacular views of Bass Lake and surrounding mountains
Premium electric mountain bikes
Small-group guided adventure

Rider Requirements
This is an advanced-level tour intended for riders with previous mountain biking experience. Participants should be comfortable riding steep terrain, technical singletrack, loose rock, and exposed granite surfaces.

If you're looking for a true High Sierra mountain biking adventure with world-class granite riding and unforgettable views, this tour delivers an experience unlike anywhere else in California.
